name: Book Return
label: Quest
description: Book Return: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: While you're investigating the Fargodeep Mine, see if you can find any of Brother Paxton's books to return. In particular, Paxton is very concerned about a book titled, "Fun with Elementals". He thinks even a kobold could use it to summon an elemental servant. Be warned, the depths of the mine are fairly dangerous. You should bring friends.
Take this book bag to protect the books when you find them!

sources.title: Quest text one player sent in, not confirmed by a second yet
